name: Senores Pharmaceuticals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2015, Senores Pharmaceuticals Ltd manufactures and develops affordable and high-quality complex generics certified by global food and drugs authorities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SPL is a global research-driven pharmaceutical company that develops and manufactures 
pharmaceutical products for the Regulated Markets of the US, Canada, and the United Kingdom across various therapeutic areas and dosage forms, with a presence in Emerging Markets. The company develops and manufactures specialty, underpenetrated, and complex pharmaceutical products. It also manufactures critical care injectables and APIs.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Debtor days have improved from 177 to 114 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 4.37 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 21.7 days to 88.2 days
